2671: Sakura is an extremely energetic and cheerful character. She is very athletic, being a member of her school's cheerleading squad and an excellent runner. She loves Physical Education and Music, but she really dislikes Math.
2897: Cerberus, nicknamed "Kero", is the appointed guardian of the book which holds the Clow Cards. He is one of two magical creatures created by Clow Reed along with the Clow Cards.
3029: Syaoran is a distant relative of Clow Reed, the creator of the Clow Cards. As a member of the Li clan of sorcerers from Hong Kong, of which Clow's mother was a member, Syaoran believes that he should be the one to inherit the Clow Cards rather than Sakura Kinomoto.
3076: In Cardcaptor Sakura Touya is the brother of Sakura Kinomoto. His birthday is on February 29th, which makes him a leap year baby, a person that can only "properly" celebrate their birthday once every four years.
3077: From the moment Yukito is introduced, it is clear that Sakura has an enormous crush on him. She continually marvels that he can be friends with her "barbaric brother."
3120: Tomoyo is the best friend of the series heroine, Sakura Kinomoto. When she discovers that Sakura has become the Cardcaptor, she becomes Sakura's primary assistant by designing "battle costumes" and filming all of her magical (and non-magical) endeavours.
3456: Eriol Hiiragizawa moved from England to transfer to Tomoeda Elementary school.
3612: Clow Reed is the magician who originally created the Clow Cards, and their magical guardians Cerberus and Yue. Born of an English father and a Chinese mother, Clow created a new type of magic that blended both Eastern and Western magical elements.
3613: Yue is one of two guardians of Clow Cards and judges candidates to become the next master of Clow Cards. Yue's appearance is that of a young man with long, silver braided hair and violet cat-like eyes (blue in the anime). He has a pair of angelic wings that he can use to fly.
3614: Fujitaka Kinomoto is a professor of archaeology at Towa University and the father of Sakura Kinomoto. Fujitaka met his late wife Nadeshiko while doing his first year as a teacher at her high school.
3615: Nadeshiko Kinomoto is the mother of the series titular character, Sakura Kinomoto, who died seven years before the series starts.
3616: Kaho Mizuki is a shrine maiden and the daughter of the priest at the Tsukimine Shrine. She first appears in the series as a new substitute teacher at Tomoeda Elementary School for the math class of Sakura Kinomoto and Syaoran Li.
3617: Ruby Moon is one of two magical guardians created by Eriol Hiiragizawa. The counterpart to the original guardian Yue, Ruby Moon is genderless but prefers to act like a female.
3618: Spinel Sun is the cat-like magical guardian created by Eriol Hiiragizawa as a counter part to Clow Reed's original guardian Cerberus. Spinel Sun's true form is a winged black panther, while his false form is similar to a small winged cat.
5771: Rika Sasaki is a classmate and friend of Sakura Kinomoto. She is considered to be very elegant and mature for her age, though she can also be shy. During the series, she is also shown to be a skilled cook and very good at crafts.
6768: Meiling Li is a character that appears only in the anime adaptation of Cardcaptor Sakura. Introduced in episode 19, she is Syaoran Li's cousin and self-proclaimed fiancée. As children living in Hong Kong, they both trained in martial arts under the tutelage of Wang Wei.
7134: Chiharu Mihara is a friend and classmate of Sakura Kinomoto, as well as a fellow member of the cheerleading squad. Chiharu is often in charge of stopping Takashi Yamazaki when he starts spinning lies about the history of objects and events.
7138: Takashi Yamazaki is a student in Sakura Kinomoto's class, and the only male student in the class to be referred to by name before the introduction of Syaoran Li. The character is named after film director, Takashi Yamazaki, who is a friend of the series creators, CLAMP.
7139: Naoko Yanagisawa is one of Sakura Kinomoto's elementary school classmates and friends. She is also on the school's cheerleading squad with Sakura, despite being rather bad at gymnastics. Naoko loves to read, particularly fantasy stories and ghost stories.
8874: Yuuki is the daughter of a painter, Tachibana Takai, who had died recently. Dressed as a boy, she caused quite a bit of trouble in the museum because she tried to restore her father's last painting
11546: Terada is a teacher at Tomoeda Elementary School. Through the fourth grade and part of the fifth-grade year, he is the homeroom teacher of Sakura Kinomoto and every other recurring elementary student character.
29244: Sonomi Daidouji is the mother of Sakura's best friend Tomoyo Daidouji, and the first cousin of Sakura's late mother Nadeshiko Kinomoto. She is said to be a wealthy woman and the President of a large toy corporation.
32625: Wei Wang is the attendant that comes with Syaoran Li when he first moves to Japan. A kind elderly man he has been teaching martial arts to Syaoran and Meilin since there childhood.
50347: She is the owner of a stuffed doll shop called Twin Bells.
285725: Masaki Amamiya is the great-grandfather of Sakura Kinomoto on her mother's side. Initially objecting to Nadeshiko's marriage to Fujitaka Kinomoto, he became more accepting upon meeting Sakura and later receiving a gift from her as a form of peace between family members.
285726: Shouko is a gentle and soft-spoken woman who is encouraging to students. She works as Tomoeda Elementary's music teacher.
295055: The Mirror is a Clow Card with the power to imitate a person's appearance. It is aligned under The Earthy and under the power of the Sun, Cerberus, and Western magic It is also one of the original nineteen cards from the manga series.
